reviews.text: I had such a great experience here! My dog was really uncomfortable and couldn’t seem to settle down, so I brought her in for an anal gland expression because that’s what I figured was wrong with her. They were able to see her quickly, figure out that her anal glands were extremely full, and took care of the problem. I could immediately tell she felt better afterward she finally went home and curled up and slept! I really appreciate how quickly they helped her and how kind everyone was. Thank you so much for taking care of my baby!

Took my fur baby in to get checked out for her back right leg. Saw Vet Sam who was very informative and did not pressure us into needless tests but helped us with a great plan and treatment for the issue. I also want to give a shout out to Chris Peake very professional and a animal lover he went up and beyond with helping my fur baby with her fever,he went out of his way to administer an IV to help reduce her fever before we left the clinic. Never in the times I went to a vet did someone do what Chris did. I will recommend these two wonderful and professional men to anyone who is looking for a great place to treat their fur baby. Bungle Veterinary is a great place highly recommended!!!!
Great service. Very kind and professional. This will be our regular clinic  from now on. Very caring staff!

Always with the best solution to our concerns and affection for my babies.  It is very gratifying every visit to Bingle Vet. 100 percent recommended.

Jules,

We truly appreciate your 5-star rating! 🌟 Your support means a lot to us. If you have any specific feedback or thoughts to share, we would love to hear from you!

My dog has an infection after getting tumor removal surgery ,she had a high fever 105.5  could of been avoided if given antibiotics once leaving the clinic. I paid $400 extra the next day .

Reception it’s need better training. And get veterinary receptionist certified through an accredited school. I am a veterinary receptionist myself and accredited however I’m not sure why there’s such mean girl, condescending and pure ignorance about saying to a receptionist “I’m not sure of this dogs age I rescued it and y’all have not seen it and I would like the vet to possible tell me her age” why would the receptionist STILL then continue to ask me it’s approximate age? Literally no common sense. I’m not sure when Bingle went downhill but I will not be coming back. I used to bring my beloved Zoey here and she made friends and was always taken to the back to say hi to everyone. Never again.
Chris and Dr Williams were very helpful !! They were very informative as well. 10 out of 10 recommend for sure

The doctors and technicians are also patient and friendly. I will drive way out of my way to bring our two cats and two dogs to Bingle Vet

I appreciate that they break things down in a way that is easy to understand and help me make informed decisions without pressuring me into anything. Everyone is kind, patient, and genuinely cares about the animals they treat. I’ve had a great experience every time I’ve brought my dog here.
They were nice to us and the cost was low.
Horrible wait times even if you have an appointment. They don't even seem to take an interest in your pets well being, just in it for the money.
Awesome  Vet..and very kind always been a great place to take your Pets..thanks so much....and I'm planning  on following  up..
Always easy going Vet, taken all my doggos here for at least 25 yrs.
My first visit was great. No wait time, nice and friendly staff.

I have an older kitty that suddenly had an arthritis/joint flare up. I am so thankful to have found this Vet! They were friendly, super gentle and loving with her and not overly pushy on high cost diagnostics and treatment. I was able to get in same day and the wait wasn't terrible at all! I have 4 other animals and am new to the area so this is an absolute blessing to find such a great place to take them. Thank you to the entire staff today, from the initial person on the phone to the front desk, vet tech and Dr. You officially have a new client and I'm sure I'll see you all very soon.
It's a Blessing to have you as Veterinary technician at Bingle Vet ELIZA!! Your kindness, your warmth, your compassion and your love for ours Dogs make you Unique! Thank you! 100% recommended

If you truly love your pet and they are dealing with a serious or severe health issue, I would not recommend coming here.

I decided to visit this clinic because one of my kittens was having a severe reaction on his face and ears, and it seemed like something serious. I needed a trustworthy veterinarian, and a friend recommended this place, which gave me confidence to come in.

The staff and assistants were genuinely kind and helpful, and I truly appreciate their customer service. However, my experience with the veterinarians was disappointing. During my first visit with Dr. Hussain Ashraf, my kitten was examined, but I was not given any clear answers about his condition. I was prescribed some pills and wipes and told to return in seven days to see if there was any improvement.

After seven days, my kitten wasn’t better—in fact, he was worse. The condition had become much more severe and had spread around his eyes, ears, and forehead, and his chin was significantly worse. What really alarmed me was how indifferent the veterinarian, Dr. Sam (Muhammad Sarmad), seemed during the visit. The examination felt very superficial and, in my opinion, not thorough given how serious my kitten’s condition was. He told me he didn’t know what my cat had, and it didn’t make sense to me that he couldn’t even have a clear idea of what it might be.

I was then given an estimate of over $400, but this wasn’t for treatment. It was only for diagnostic tests to try to determine what my kitten might have. Because of this, I decided not to move forward and sought a second opinion at another veterinary clinic. There, they properly examined my kitten, provided appropriate treatment, and were able to identify the issue without requiring expensive additional tests. I ended up paying significantly less than what I was quoted here just to find out what my kitten had.

Overall, I felt the pricing at this clinic was overpriced, and it honestly made me feel like the focus was more on generating money rather than genuinely caring for and treating my kitten, which was very disappointing and sad.

While I don’t think this is a bad clinic, I would recommend exploring other options if your pet is dealing with a serious or complex health issue. In my experience, this place felt more suited for routine care like vaccines or minor concerns. For more critical conditions, I would suggest finding a veterinarian who takes a more thorough and solution-focused approach.

Update: The owner contacted me directly to make things right. She expressed genuine concern for what happened and said that they specifically spoke to that vet about his behavior. When Esther had an allergic reaction again to medication, they opened up a spot immediately for me and I was able to go directly to their head vet, Dr.Vaughn. The visit was completely free of charge (it was a $800 visit) and they gave Esther the BEST care while she was feeling her worst. Dr.Vaughn  was personable, funny, and took extra time to explain Esther’s issues. If you go—make sure to specifically for him!! I will be returning ☺️——————————————-/////////////////////////////They write you prescriptions they can't fill and won't approve any other establishment to fill them either. Dr. Huessin didn't believe my cat had fleas, before he even touched her started talking about allergy testing and all kinds of tests that might need to be to run. Money grabbing from the get go.  Looked at her and goes...oh yeah it's fleas. yeah, thats what we said. We explained our cat Esther had experienced severe allergic reactions to 4 different flea medications we had tried and he acted like he didn't believe us. Obviously wanting to push the flea medication at the practice which we had already purchased before for $182 and had not worked for our cat. Finally gave us an RX and wouldn't approve chewy.com fill it and no where in town wanted to fill it either. After finally finding a Kroger that could order it, the vet wasn't credible enough to have Kroger fill the RX. Bingle vet didn't push, they just told Kroger to return the script to me. After calling to complain they finally  called back Kroger and got the RX to be approved by switching to another, I guess more credible vet in their practice. They should have done that to begin with. I wasted a huge amount of time and they showed no compassion on me or my sweet cat, Esther. Never returning. Save yourself.

Haley is by far THE BEST receptionist Bingle vet has ever hired.
1. She truly cares about the patients and the pet parents and listens attentively to get correct
2.She does NOT speak to me in a condescending but sweet manner as previous receptionists have.
4. She is THE SWEETEST and All your receptionist need to learn from her about how to speak to pet parents and on how to bring info to vets and to relay info.
Please get her accredited through AHAA and certified as a veterinary receptionst. She deserves a raise!
She helped me with Esther who had pus in her stool. I was also able to talk about my other dogs bad behavior and to se rid it s nutritional deficiency that we can supplement or just correct the behavior. Keenan - We're sorry to see the 2-star rating and would love to understand what happened. I don't recognize the name, would you kindly contact us directly at 713.468.1676 and ask for Caroline so that I can better understand your visit.

When we first started bringing our 5-year-old chihuahua mix to Bingle Vet, the service and staff seemed great. Unfortunately, things quickly went downhill once our dog started having health issues that required testing. The front desk staff are completely clueless and rarely seem to know what they’re talking about, and they can’t provide clear information about anything.

It felt like once tests were involved, the quality of care declined significantly. We spent a lot of money and it honestly feels like we just threw it down the drain. They could never give us a proper diagnosis and instead kept throwing medication after medication at our dog hoping something would work — but nothing ever did.

What’s frustrating is that we took our dog to another vet and they were able to diagnose him in one visit. On top of that, our dog was always extremely anxious whenever we went to Bingle Vet. The technicians even said they had to muzzle him because he supposedly snapped at them. However, at the new vet he was calm the entire time and never showed any signs of aggression. He was also allowing the Dr and his technicians to pick him up without any hesitation.

Overall, our experience was disappointing and very frustrating. We trusted them with our baby and spent a lot of money without ever getting real answers. If you have the ability to spend a little more money take your fur babies to someone who will actually care.

Very poor service. I made an appointment with them and after an hour's wait, when I asked why it had taken so long, they excused themselves by saying the doctor was busy. In other words, they don't focus on the dogs' health. I do not recommend this clinic; the service is terrible.

Absolutely incredible care! They treated my dog like their own and made us both feel so comfortable. Professional, compassionate, and truly the best in the business. Five stars isn't enough!"

We had an emergency with our little pup, and from the minute we walked through those doors I knew she was in good hands. The staff was warm and friendly,  and the level of care they provided was top notch. The clinic was spotless, Dr. Vaughan was amazing and our little Princess is back on track.
Profession, don’t make us wait, kind staff.   Would definitely recommend!    Just can’t imagine a better experience for our pet!

I have been bringing my pets to Bingle Veterinary Clinic for many years. Today, I had to make the heartbreaking decision to put my dog down.
During the process, while I was giving my dog treats and saying goodbye, the veterinarian injected the sedative without clearly telling us it was being administered at that moment. I did not realize what was happening until my dog began to lose balance and struggle.
This was already one of the most painful experiences of my life, and the lack of communication made it even more distressing. In such a vulnerable moment, I believe pet owners deserve clear guidance about each step of the process so they can be emotionally prepared.
I hope the clinic takes this feedback seriously and improves communication during end-of-life care for families going through such a devastating time.

Also want to say Brandon the veterinary technician is so awesome

Do not waste your time here. They can't communicate and have no sense of urgency.
I called over an hour before my appointment time to verify that they did a panleukopenia test (parvo in dogs) on kittens because I had one that was exposed. The front desk checked with the care team and confirmed they did, so I drove 25 minutes in traffic to get there. I was left in the exam room for 20 minutes until someone came in and told me they were out of the tests.
This disease is lethal in kittens if they aren't given proper care and is something that, if caught early, can be controlled by a regular vet without needing emergency care.
Why not actually check when I called to see if they had the test instead of wasting my time to come all the way out there and then leaving me with no other option to test?
I will never recommend this place to anyone and will be finding a new vet for my pets.

I paid $2000 on my dog for a tooth cleaning and a small lesion removal.  The vet did call, and recommended removing a right lower molar, but everything else looked fine, even though my dog had a left upper pump on his face (which was an infected molar, not picked up by the Bingle Vet).  A month later I got to take him to a different vet and repeat the surgery for the infected molar to the right upper jaw along with repeating the right lower jaw molar extraction which evidently was not removed correctly.  So, considering I got to repeat the procedure twice, I would not recommend Bingle Veterinary Clinic.  And talking to Leslie, the office manager, honestly took over holding about 90 minutes total between 4 phone calls.  My dog is doing great now.

We took in a kitty for a visit since he was a bit wobbly. The doctor recommended bloodwork and x-rays before even checking his ears to see if it has anything to do with an infection causing imbalance. The ear test came back negative so we moved onto blood testing. However, due to a storm, the third-party crew came to pick up the blood samples earlier that day, so we were told to come back the following week. During checkout the doctor confirmed that I would have to pay another recheck fee in order to get the blood test!

I’ve never been to another vet where they would charge another exam fee for something such as this, especially when it wasn’t our fault that we couldn’t get the blood test the same day! They clearly only care about money.

Also the tech and doctor was not confident at all. They told me multiple times what a strange and unusual situation this was.

Let me tell you this has been the most impressed that I’ve been with a business and a very, very, very long time. I just moved to the neighborhood, googled this Veterinarian and decided to give it a try. I could not be more satisfied with the entire staff! A biggg shout out to the amazing Dr. Vaughn!! He is truly outstanding and a very smart doctor who educates you on your pet’s condition. I brought in my litter of five Yorkies and he knew exactly how to handle my situation. Dr. Vaughn genuinely goes above and beyond for your pets! I can actually say each staff member really cares about the health and condition of your pet. The clinic is super clean and well kept, and I would encourage anyone to visit this facility.

If you love your pet, you will not take them to Bingle Vet. Our dog has been a patient there for about 4 years and up until recently things were generally okay. She had a mass on her tail that Dr. Mark Silberman said was operable and decided to remove it. While he told us that the skin was thin to suture together, he said the surgery was a success. He never offered amputation which come to find out, is the typical suggested surgery to remove such a growth. Between the date of the surgery and about two weeks post op, we returned 4 times for bandage changes. Later finding out that bandage changes were supposed to occur more frequently. This was NEVER communicated to us nor listed in her discharge papers. Upon the 4th trip we found out that the site was severely infected when 3 days prior Dr. Silberman ensured us the surgery site was healing well and had no concerns. They sent us home with a scheduled amputation date. Our dog did not make it to that date as we later came to the conclusion the amputation was emergent. We visited our local vet ER and had the tail amputated. Due to Dr. Silberman’s negligence and lies, our dog now is an amputee, and we’re down nearly $4000 between the two surgeries. We have reported Dr. Silberman to the Texas Veterinary Board for his malpractice. I will finish this review by saying that Dr. Williams WAS in fact honest with us about her recovery and did what she could to try & help us. Unfortunately, it was too late and the infection was too severe. Point of the story, don’t let Dr. Silberman operate on your pets unless you want to be lied to, pay extra, and have your pet suffer at the hands of a negligent vet.

Brough my dog in for an appointment to update vaccines and they were very quick to get it all done with me. Brandon was very helpful and informative of what I needed for my dog. Bonus free biscuits for my dog too!

Bingle Vet is most definitely the gold star standard for any pet! Knowledgeable, compassionate, and genuinely care about your pet! I have been going there since the 80s. Dr Vaughn Sr.and if you're not taking your beloved pet there you are missing out! As well as your pet

I initially took my cat to Bingle Vet Clinic because my regular veterinarian didn’t have any immediate availability, and my cat had developed a mass on his face. I brought him in on a Saturday for testing and was told I would receive the results by Tuesday at the latest. However, I didn’t hear back until Friday, at which point I was informed that my cat had cancer. The veterinarian said someone would contact me with a quote for surgery and to schedule the procedure, but no one ever followed up. I had to reach out via email to request a quote myself, and even then, no one contacted me to actually schedule the surgery. In that email, I specifically asked for available surgery dates and times, but no one has gotten back to me. I also called the clinic to speak with the veterinarian directly to ask some follow-up questions and was told she would call me back, but I never received a call. To this day, no one from the clinic has reached out to schedule the surgery. I ended up taking my cat to his regular vet, who was able to schedule the surgery the next day. Based on this experience, I would not recommend Bingle Vet Clinic to anyone.

If I could do 0 stars I truly Wholeheartedly would. -  WHOLE HEARTEDLY

Update : the own “doctors/owners" calling me a liar after the doctor making fun of teddy told me directly he was actively seizing. And after seeing multiple reviews clearly the paw keepsake is a reoccurring issue. So unprofessional in general PLEASE DO NOT TAKE YOUR FURRY LOVE ONE HERE

On August 5th, 2025, I rushed my dog, Teddy, to this veterinary clinic during a medical emergency. He was actively seizing, barking between seizures, and bleeding. I arrived at 7:35 AM with my family, only to be told the doctor would not be in until 8:00 AM — despite posted business hours of 7:00 AM–7:00 PM.

While filling out paperwork in tears, a man emerged from the back with another dog and made a joke: “You guys hear that? I don’t hear anything,” referring to my seizing dog. This was my first impression — no empathy, no urgency.

We were finally moved to a room at 8:10 AM. An assistant confirmed euthanasia was the most humane option. To my shock, the “doctor” who arrived was the same man who made the earlier joke, meaning he had been present the entire time.

Before any treatment, I was told payment had to be completed in full upfront while my dog was still actively seizing on the table. Processing issues with multiple cards delayed care even longer. Only after payment cleared did the euthanasia proceed, and Teddy passed within 10 minutes.

I had also paid for a paw print keepsake, but later received a call saying paw prints were “only included with cremation” and that I would be refunded. By that point, Teddy had already been buried, making it impossible to have any final keepsake of him.

This experience was cold, unprofessional, and deeply hurtful during one of the most vulnerable moments of my life. I strongly urge this clinic to reevaluate their protocols, staff training, and compassion standards so no grieving pet owner ever experiences this level of disregard again.

I experienced absolutely horrible service at Bingle Vet today. I have been a customer at Bingle Vet for 11 years, and after today, I will never be going back there.

My dog had a teeth cleaning procedure today. He is still young (not even 5 years old yet) and he only eats dry food. At his annual checkup last year, the vet said his teeth were in good shape and said cleaning wasn’t necessary at that time. At his annual checkup this year, the vet recommended teeth cleaning. He was starting to have tartar buildup, but it didn’t seem like anything outrageous or that his teeth were in dire shape. We took the vet’s advice though and got his teeth cleaned. We were SHOCKED to find out that they pulled 9 of my dog’s teeth during the procedure!! Nine!!! 🤯

I don’t understand how a dog that had teeth in good shape last year, that only eats dry food and is not even 5 years old needs to get 9 teeth pulled! He didn’t even have bad breath that typically accompanies teeth that need to be removed. There was no indication or heads up from the vet that his teeth were diseased and decaying to necessitate so many teeth needing to be pulled. He has no front teeth left!

I believe the vet completely took advantage of us. I feel that they pulled teeth unnecessarily just to be able to charge us the high end of the price range they quoted us. Such a scam! We asked to speak to the doctor at pickup today and were brushed off and only able to discuss his procedure with front desk staff and a technician who gave us no real answers. I am beyond upset with Bingle Vet and feel absolutely horrible for my poor dog.

Long wait times/rushed care. We have been going there for a while. They used to pay for your pets exam if they didn’t have your pet in a room after 15 minutes, but they had to get rid of that because expect to wait 15 minutes minimum.

The Vets are nice but they are very difficult about getting medication and with their prescriptions. I was told that I could have a prescription for my dog for his flea medication but then they wouldn't let me buy medication from them. I told them I was out and my dog was at risk for fleas and they told me they can't help even though they sell the medication there. It was absurd, they told me they can either give me my prescription for my dog or I can buy from them. I told them I wanted it shipped from chewy. Thevets are extremely difficult as they won't even fax the prescription over. They even denied a refill request and capped it at 1 refill per prescription needing another appointment before I can get medication again. I am currently snail mailing a prescription across the country just to get medication while my dog is out of flea medication. The entire office didn't seem to want to help in this regard. I let them know other vets are not this difficult with getting medication and I let them know I won't be going back because of this. They act like the Mafia withholding your dogs flea medication from you.  There are much easier to work with vets for a better price. This is a gotcha type sales tactic that I did not appreciate. Bingle vet if you read this y'all need to start working with chewy and let your old ideas of gate keeping medication in the past. Sincerely Thomas.

I'm only editing my review to respond to the clinic. Chewy, I highly reputable company isn't sketchy. You want to reassess my dogs flea medication is crazy and your fear mongering to other or potential dog owners and patients isn't going to be received well by the general public. Y'all let me come in, pay 300 for services then refused to let me buy medication from y'all, all because I wanted a physical prescription. My dog still doesn't have flea medication as you refused to sell it to me. This is extortion, no amount of fear mongering about bad medication from Amazon pet clinics is going to change my mind.  I came in with my dog Canelo and I wanted to buy flea medication from y'all which you denied me that ability as soon as I said I wanted a physical prescription. That was wrong of y'all if your policy is to be rude and not caring for my dog that's your puroggotive. But I won't be back with Canelo and I won't bring another dog to pay high prices then have the vet refuse to supply me with flea medication.

Thank you for the 5 stars.
Thank you for the 5 stars.

Dr Seeman is the best. She is extremely nice, and very caring. She is very thorough and explains everything step by step in so much detail. I am definitely veg happy that I found this place, and found her..! I hope to be here for many years with my Benji and coco 🐶🐾

My vet bill was $400 just for vaccines and less than an oz of medicine and said my cat NEEDED them. Got a second opinion and was charged a FRACTION of the cost. Just because I have money does not mean I like being taken advantage of.
My service here the first time was incredible! Here a second time for my baby girl! I love the doctors here.

Hello, I'd like to know if you offer support in Spanish.

Thank you very much, I hope you can reply 🙌🏻 …
The staff is great and very friendly! Best experience we've had at any veterinary clinic.
Very very knowledgeable vet here.

Edit: dropping my review down to one star. I noticed there was a mistake on one of the prescriptions that was written—they prescribed medication for a cat weighing 5-11 lbs, when my cat weighs 12 lbs. I went back today to try to get a corrected prescription, and/or a prescription for the generic version. I was told again that it would take 24-48 hours. It takes them two days to fix a mistake that they made?? It’s just printing a new paper and signing it. Meanwhile, my cats are suffering, and I am left with no options. It’s Saturday, so I won’t get a new prescription until Monday. I can’t fill the prescription as written, because there is a mistake. My cats need this medication and I have been given no other options.

Honestly, I was hoping this vet would be my new vet for the life of my cats, but I will never be back. I am honestly shocked at the lack of accountability and responsibility for their mistake, leaving me and my cats with no options (other than shelling out an additional $70+ for a single dose of a different medication!)

Original review: I brought my two cats here today for the first time.

Pros: the clinic is very clean, everyone is very nice and professional, and the doctor was very sweet with my cats. I have no concerns at all about how they run their clinic and treat the animals.

Cons: the process for getting a common prescription filled for my cats has been arduous to say the least.

I came in because my two cats have fleas, and OTC flea prevention wasn’t working. They wrote me a prescription for Revolution, and told me I would have to fill it elsewhere because they didn’t have it in stock.

Ok, fine. Where should I fill this prescription? They recommended H-E-B, Walgreens,
Petsmart, Costco. Dead Reader, I went to FOUR different pharmacies and no one could fill this Rx. Ok, fine, I will order it on Chewy. I called Bingle Vet back, and told them I would like to order the Rx online. They told me they “do not work with outside pharmacies.” They would not approve the prescription over the phone with Chewy. Huh? But y’all wrote me a paper Rx, you can’t fill my prescription, and neither can four other pharmacies, so what should I do? They suggested I mail in my prescription to Chewy. Which I guess would work, but wow that is super inconvenient, and now my cats have to suffer for longer while USPS handles things. I pushed back, and tried to understand why they have this policy, and I was told something about not being able to verify the correct medication. This is very strange to me, as I’ve been a pet owner for decades and have never had this problem. Chewy.com is a lifesaver, why won’t they work with them?

So, now I’ve run all over Houston, still don’t have my cats’ prescription, and Bingle Vet won’t work with Chewy, other than to say I have to mail in a piece of paper like it’s 1999. The internet is wonderful new modern convenience y’all, I think we should jump on board. (/s)

Also, side note, the Rx was for Revolution, but I decided later I would like the generic, Selarid. The price difference is literally $100 X 2 cats, so $200 savings! I called Bingle Vet to see if I could get the (paper) prescription changed, having accepted my fate of mailing it in to Chewy. I was told this will take “24-48 hours to be approved.” Wow.

I spent hundreds of dollars there today, and they seem hell-bent on making this prescription process difficult. And this is not an uncommon thing—it’s flea prevention for goodness sake! For this reason, I don’t think I’ll be back.

Two stars because they seem nice in person, and I did like the doctor. But my gosh this has been an ordeal.

Cheers to 30+ more years!!
